protocol.authorization: User requested necessary fair comparisons and explicitly approved a separate limit of 10 GPU-hours.

training.data: unchanged original train/validation with original sampling
training.checkpoint: maximum original validation BA at logit threshold0; then lower BCE; then earlier update

pilots.selection: full original validation at update3000; highest BA, lowest BCE, lower LR; confirmation does not retune

comparisons.cost: quality versus measured latency, throughput, memory and actual operation counts; no claim of equal cost at equal radius
comparisons.remaining_confound: R models share weights; F models have independent blocks. Radius matching does not isolate recurrence or parameter sharing.

test.selection: all generated examples; no label balancing or model-score filtering for random far
test.exact_duplicates: exclude labeled adjacencies from v1 and reweight_v2 and within v3
test.topology: new random draws, not claimed isomorphically disjoint; plain stress remains a radius diagnostic
test.branches: mirrored auxiliary incoming trees attached to the two chains; source-target shortest path stays ell; no source access to auxiliary nodes
test.closed: new test model predictions only after all30 new finals and all80 best checkpoints are frozen

metrics.calibration: one additional scalar threshold per checkpoint from original full validation only; maximize BA, tie closest to0, then lower threshold
metrics.threshold_candidates: 0, all distinct validation logits, nextafter(max logit,+inf); prediction logit>=threshold
metrics.timing: warmup10 repeats30; n32,64,128; batch1 and64; state-norm instrumentation disabled only during timing

statistics.claims: exploratory, no multiplicity-adjusted significance; seeds do not replace independent graph topologies

budget.includes: GPU smoke/profile, pilots, finals, inference, failures and scheduler overhead
budget.admission: full prespecified grid estimate with1.2reserve must fit; never silently reduce seeds or updates
